story.titleZh: 梅赛德斯车队：杆位超乎预期，周末努力调整
story.summaryZh: 梅赛德斯车队在奥斯汀排位赛中取得杆位，表示这一成绩超出了他们的预期。

story.originalTitle: 💬 “Taking pole position today was beyond our expectations heading into the session. We’ve been working hard to get the car into a good window all...
story.summaryEn:
💬 “Taking pole position today was beyond our expectations heading into the session. We’ve been working hard to get the car into a good window all weekend, and we’ve been chipping away at it.”
Hear from Kimi, George and Toto after the Austin Qualifying 👉https://bit.ly/USASatReportTW
detailZh:
💬 “今天取得杆位超出了我们进入排位赛时的预期。我们整个周末都在努力让赛车进入一个良好的区间，我们一直在逐步改进。”
听来自基米、乔治和托托在奥斯汀排位赛后的看法 👉https://bit.ly/USASatReportTW
detailEn:
💬 “Taking pole position today was beyond our expectations heading into the session. We’ve been working hard to get the car into a good window all weekend, and we’ve been chipping away at it.”
Hear from Kimi, George and Toto after the Austin Qualifying 👉https://bit.ly/USASatReportTW
